walkableNote: THE BARE BOARDS. The wardrobe's foot is at y 665, the desk's at 710, the chair's at 752, the washstand's at 685; the bed's foot posts stand forward at y 810. So the band runs y 760-858 from the door to the bed, and only its nearest strip, y 820 on, passes in front of the bed's foot: he never stands where the bed is drawn over him.

scaling.note: ROOM 19'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad stood with his feet at y 782 and was drawn about 457 tall (tools/room19-graybox.py planned 440 at 745 and 516 at 855); along that slope, 0.68 a row as Room 5's, that is 450 at the band's far edge and 517 at its near.

entrances.note: In by the door, at left, from the stairs up from the lobby.
In by the door, at left.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32), smallest first. THE LETTERS HOME (doc 05) is THE OUTGOING LETTER (doc 08), the sheet begun on the desk (errata 69 C); HIS MOTHER'S LETTERS are the bundle tied with string; the case is the small dark box between them. THE WALL is the thin plank wall to the next room, at the right, beside the bed (doc 26 note 1). THE FLOORBOARDS are the strip of boards behind the walk band, under the window. THE COAT hangs on the door, and an exit is hit before any hotspot, so THE DOOR is the panel below the coat, from y 500 to the sill; the coat is the door above it.

THE DOOR.note: Doc 26: THE DOOR → Room 18, with its own LOOK and LISTEN; doc 05's THE DOOR is the same door (errata 69 C).

lamps.note: The lamp on the desk, the room's one light.

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object here is looked at on a bare click.

letters_home.note: Doc 04 Part Three: the letters home are 'available in Thad's hotel room in every act'. USE on the letter he is writing opens the act's three versions in Acts I-III, and in Act IV reads the only version offered, 'No choice. Four lines.' Nothing is set (invariant 10).

occlusion.note: No plane: nothing stands nearer the camera than the walk band except the bed's foot, and the band passes in front of it only at y 820 and nearer. Nobody else is here.
